limitations: No physical-print test conducted by this sub-agent.
Photo-internal natural writing (whiteboard, clothing, monitor content, classroom posters) is distinguished from deliberately placed publication copy; not all such natural writing is editable type.
This audit identifies problematic text; it is not a replacement PDF or an acceptance certificate.
Outlined paths are never counted as text. P12-14 only passed the earlier narrower no-raster-publication-text check; they do not pass the true-text master requirement.
critical_definition: Text means live PDF text with font/character semantics. Vector outlines are paths, not text. An outlined print derivative must never be described as an editable-text master.
